• Chennaiyin FC vs East Bengal FC || Match Content || Highlights || Match 28 || 07-Nov-2026 || English ||
Eight goals in Chennai! Watch the big moments as Chennaiyin FC beat defending champions East Bengal FC 5-3 to pick up their first win of the MG Indian Super League 2026-27.
Brison Fernandes struck twice early. Aké Arnaud Loba pulled one back, but Ramon’s penalty made it 3-1 at half-time. Dani Ramírez’s penalty brought East Bengal back within one, before Irfan Yadwad scored twice in eight minutes to settle it. David Lalhlansanga’s stoppage-time goal was only a consolation.
